title: Oliver Reiser's tone theory and letters with Puharich

plain: A philosopher at the University of Pittsburgh named Oliver Reiser held a theory of the universe built on tones, set out in his work Cosmic Humanism, and traded dozens of letters with the scientist Puharich in the 1960s and 70s. An unnamed researcher on the show tells this in his own summary, also bringing in Albert Einstein, saying Puharich "knew this guy. They exchanged like dozens and dozens of letters." It matters to the story of Puharich's own ideas about contact with other beings.
